inputs.name: ticks

device.name: Humanoid AMP (Isaac Lab DirectRLEnv, dance task)

facts.text: The package registers Isaac-Humanoid-AMP-Dance-Direct-v0, Isaac-Humanoid-AMP-Run-Direct-v0 and Isaac-Humanoid-AMP-Walk-Direct-v0 with entry point humanoid_amp_env:HumanoidAmpEnv
HumanoidAmpEnv is an Isaac Lab DirectRLEnv
The scene spawns the robot with Articulation and the ground with spawn_ground_plane
The configured observation space is 81 values, the action space 28 values and the state space 0
The config keeps two AMP observations of 81 values each
The action offset is the midpoint of the robot's soft joint-position limits and the action scale is their span
Each applied action becomes the joint-position target action_offset + action_scale * action
The episode is configured to last 10.0 s and each environment step decimates 2 physics steps
The physics step is 1/60 s and the simulation configures PhysX
Early termination is enabled with a termination height of 0.5
The reference body of the generic humanoid environment is the torso
The default reset strategy is random: it samples motion times unless the strategy is random-start or default
The scene config sets num_envs 4096 and env_spacing 10.0
The observation concatenates joint positions, joint velocities, the root height, tangent and normal vectors, root linear and angular velocities and the key-body positions relative to the root
The generic humanoid reward is one for every environment at every step
The episode truncates when the episode-length buffer reaches max_episode_length - 1 and terminates early when the reference body is below termination_height
A random reset samples motion times, writes the sampled root pose and velocity plus joint positions and velocities, and updates the AMP observation buffer
The AMP observation buffer holds num_amp_observations times amp_observation_space values per environment

determinism.notes: reset(seed) re-seeds the environment's random generator; this package checked repeatability only on the fake, whose initial joint draws are seeded. The upstream motion sampling with numpy and the GPU physics were not run here and are not claimed bit-exact

gaps: the fake backend is kinematic: it integrates the action as a small joint-position increment and models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators, gravity, sensors or noise
the fake presents one unbatched environment with flat (28,) and (81,) spaces, while the upstream scene config batches 4096 environments by default and returns a {'policy': ...} observation
the fake never terminates on the 0.5 m reference-body height because it has no balance model; it only truncates at the 10.0 s episode length
the fake's initial joint values are Python random.Random draws, not samples of the upstream motion clips; the upstream reset samples the .npz motions with numpy
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and ticks advance simulated time only; the 16.67 ms timestep is the physics step, while the control period is two such steps (about 33.33 ms)
snapshot and restore are not offered: neither the upstream DirectRLEnv nor the fake exposes get_state()/set_state()
no physical device is modelled and the Isaac Sim/PhysX environment was never run or validated here

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step, reset or seed is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
